pirates_n_ships.configuration.core.debug: Log extra debug information from Pirates 'n' Ships systems
pirates_n_ships.configuration.sailing.an: How strongly a holding anchor brakes the ship's horizontal motion
Ticks from dropping the anchor until it holds fully
Cap of the anchor force divided by ship mass, in blocks per second squared
Ticks from raising the anchor until it is stowed
Distance in blocks an anchored ship may drift before the rode pulls it back
How hard a holding anchor pulls the ship back per block beyond the slack
pirates_n_ships.configuration.sailing.ha: Fraction of the full sail force a half-set sail produces
pirates_n_ships.configuration.sailing.ke: Hulls resist sideways motion in water (needed to sail across or against the wind)
Extra water drag across the hull, per second
Extra water drag along the hull, per second (fraction of speed lost per second)
Multiplier on the turning resistance the keel causes
pirates_n_ships.configuration.sailing.ru: Rudder side force per unit of ship mass, forward speed and rudder deflection
pirates_n_ships.configuration.sailing.sa: Sail force per block of sail area and per block/s of apparent wind
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.gust_: Largest change of wind direction during a gust, in degrees
Extra wind strength at the peak of the strongest gust, as a fraction (0.4 = +40%)
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.gusts: Thunderstorms produce short gusts of extra wind
Average number of gusts per minute during a full thunderstorm
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.max_s: Highest clear-weather wind speed in blocks per second (raised to min_strength if lower)
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.min_s: Lowest clear-weather wind speed in blocks per second
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.regio: Largest regional deviation of the wind direction, in degrees
Distance in blocks over which the regional wind pattern changes
Largest regional deviation of the wind strength, as a fraction (0.3 = plus or minus 30%)
Wind direction and strength differ by region instead of being the same everywhere in a dimension
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.sync_: How often the wind is sent to each player, in ticks
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.varia: How fast wind direction and strength drift. 1 = direction changes over about one in-game day, 0 = frozen
pirates_n_ships.configuration.wind.weath: Rain and thunderstorms strengthen the wind and storms bring gusts
